cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(fx C)
enable_testing()
add_library(core src/core.c)
add_executable(app src/main.c)
target_link_libraries(app core)
add_executable(t_core tests/t_core.c)
target_link_libraries(t_core core)
add_test(NAME core_ok COMMAND t_core)
set_tests_properties(core_ok PROPERTIES LABELS "unit;fast")
add_test(NAME app_ok COMMAND app)
